result.rationale: The rescue objective makes no progress across 6 turns (0/2 civilians extracted) despite the team repeatedly reaching the relevant zones. The dominant causal blocker is spatial/hostile pressure: Engineer Imani is repeatedly attacked by Raider Holt (29 then 25 damage, dropping to 36 health), the reactor hazard bleeds health each turn (reactor-heat climbs 62→100, dealing 10 damage/turn to actors in reactor zones), and Medic Reyes's escort route to the rescue airlock is contested twice (turn 4 target_zone_capacity_lost blocking the escort path, and turn 1 hive-alpha contested). The team is funneled through the power-junction/reactor corridor where hostile pirates and the reactor hazard converge, preventing the escort from reaching the airlock and draining the team's health and resources (battery 48→36, oxygen 68→42). This is survival/spatial pressure blocking the useful affordance (extraction) rather than a knowledge or local-policy problem.
